_comment: Every *Continuation renderer name the YouTube TV app registers in its own
renderer table, taken verbatim from the shipped kabuki bundle (main.js,
the `new _.S("...")` declarations). Captured rather than invented: the
whole point is that this list is the app's, not ours.
A continuation that carries shelves or tiles has to be routed through
processShelves, or everything the mod does to a tile silently stops
applying to content that arrives that way.
